subject: [PATCH v3 08/14] SUNRPC: stop the svc_unregister() sweep once rpcbind stops answering

2026-08-28.patch_summary: This patch modifies the SUNRPC service to stop clearing rpcbind entries after the first call that receives no answer from rpcbind. This change is intended to prevent unnecessary timeouts and improve performance when a local rpcbind never replies.
